The device tree compatible string for the WM8960 codec is `wolfson,wm8960`, which correctly maps to `DT_HAS_WOLFSON_WM8960_ENABLED`. Because of the typo, `CONFIG_AUDIO_CODEC_WM8960` was not enabled, which in turn prevented `CONFIG_AUDIO_CODEC_WM8960_EMUL` from being enabled (as it depends on `AUDIO_CODEC_WM8960`). Consequently, the `if AUDIO_CODEC_WM8960_EMUL` block in `tests/drivers/audio/wm8960/Kconfig` was skipped, and `CONFIG_WM8960_EMUL_LOG_LEVEL` was never defined, leading to the compilation error.

The fix involves correcting the typo in `drivers/audio/Kconfig.wm8960`.
